{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Check for duplicates
print("Duplicate order_id:", sales_df['order_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check the distribution of channels
print("Channel distribution:\n", Counter(sales_df['channel']))

# Check if any orders are both completed and refunded (should be mutually exclusive)
refunded_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded']['order_id']
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']['order_id']
overlap = len(set(refunded_orders) & set(completed_orders))
print(f"Orders that are both refunded and completed: {overlap}")"}
